title: Cloud TPU system architecture
note: The authoritative reference: TensorCore/MXU, the TPU VM model, chips → slices → Pods, and generations.

title: Run a calculation on a TPU VM with JAX
note: Provision a TPU VM, SSH in, and run your first JAX program on the chip.

title: JAX quickstart — run your first matmul
note: Run a matmul in JAX (on a TPU VM if you have one), then dump the HLO to see XLA lower it onto the MXU.

title: Work the bandwidth math
prompt: For a 128×128 systolic MXU fed from HBM at ~2.8 TB/s, explain why a CPU's fetch-per-op model is memory-bound while the array is compute-bound. Define arithmetic intensity, then show how switching fp32 → bf16 and increasing batch size each change where the bottleneck sits.

title: Jupiter Rising: Clos topologies & centralized control (SIGCOMM 2015)
note: Google's datacenter-network paper — the centralized, software-defined control plane that later reconfigures the OCS. Background on the SDN/Clos foundation, not the OCS itself; for OCS specifics see the Mission Apollo (2022) and TPU v4 ISCA (2023) papers.
